mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS updater_master ( updater_code VARCHAR(20) PRIMARY KEY, updater_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL )
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_master ( product_code VARCHAR(20) PRIMARY KEY, product_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, product_category VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, updater_code VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL )
ALTER TABLE product_master ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS product_category VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO updater_master (updater_code, updater_name) VALUES ('U001', '山田 太郎'), ('U002', '佐藤 花子'), ('U003', '鈴木 次郎') ON CONFLICT (updater_code) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_code AS productCode, p.product_name AS productName, p.product_category AS productCategory, p.updater_code AS updaterCode, COALESCE(u.updater_name, '') AS updaterName FROM product_master p LEFT JOIN updater_master u ON p.updater_code = u.updater_code ORDER BY p.product_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_master ( product_code, product_name, product_category, updater_code ) VALUES ( #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{productCategory}, #{updaterCode} )
